key_decisions.decision: Preserves the two dimensions and the difficult foundation wording without inventing a length.
Keeps the stone/timber specification and source’s new timber wording alongside its uncertain construction sense.
Retains the brutal penalty and destruction of the offender’s house rather than euphemizing royal coercion.
Preserves the name-dwelling image, royal curse, and emphatic closing signature.
Retains all three kings, including the later Artaxerxes, without changing the source’s retrospective scope.
Makes the slaughtering agents explicit from the recipient distinction while retaining the shared purification.
Retains the joining of additional worshipers and their stated separation and purpose without deciding their ancestry.
Preserves the surprising Assyria title and both heart and hands images rather than harmonizing the ruler’s designation.
